name: @opencues/windows
description: OpenCues for Windows — a system-wide host. A WSL-side daemon runs the OpenCues runtime against your existing ~/.cues config + keys; a thin Windows-native UI Automation shim mirrors whatever text field you're typing in. Full integration (marks, cues, cycling, blanks, per-pixel-alpha overlay, real caret) on native text surfaces — Notepad, WordPad, the browser omnibox, Explorer, Win32/WinForms/WPF fields. Chromium-embedded apps (Slack-class) get real geometry + cues under the screen-reader flag with commit-on-release writes; pre-flag Chromium and Discord-class apps run the phase-1 blanks-only profile. See CLAUDE.md for the per-app tier table.
//comment-on-os: The daemon runs in WSL/Linux. The native shim (native/OpenCuesWindows.cs) runs on Windows and is compiled on-demand by OpenCuesWindows.ps1 — it is not an npm-built artifact, so this package's `os` is linux (where the daemon lives).

scripts.build: echo '@opencues/windows: no build (hostd.cjs runs the staged @opencues/runtime dist directly; the Windows shim is Add-Type-compiled on Windows)'

//comment-on-opencues-deps: @opencues/{core,runtime} are staged into node_modules by patches/setup.sh (cp -r built dist), mirroring integrations/shell. hostd.cjs also falls back to the repo's packages/ dir for dev runs straight from the tree.
